cases.title: Pendant blocks motive certainty but not a surface thought

cases.finalState: Pendant still ready; motive field blocked; surface-thought spell handled by its own reviewed procedure.

cases.title: Transfer cannot refresh pendant
cases.initialState: Bearer spent pendant charge earlier and transfers the pendant before completing any beneficial Long Rest while still bonded/possessing it.

cases.finalState: No pre-transfer rest ambiguity and no swap-reset exploit; charge becomes1 only on the new bearer’s qualifying rest.
